purpose: Exploratory matched historical Codex versus OpenCode harness comparison, analogous to the DAB harness study; no presupposed direction or negligible effect.
result_policy: Preserve every attempt. Never rerun ordinary wrong answers. Evidenced provider, simulator, Docker, sleep or I/O interruption is infrastructure failure and excluded pending recovery. Never select best score.
smoke_policy: First sampled case across all four backends in each mode counts as formal. Release remaining work after native model, mode, isolation, prompt, assets and scoring audit; correctness does not control release.
comparison: Paired by case, backend and mode; report discordant outcomes and case-cluster uncertainty. Same benchmark task prompt, data, evaluator, image, timeout and requested model/effort. Agent-internal system instructions, tools and execution strategy belong to the harness treatment. Historical runs are not contemporaneous; stochasticity, backend model updates and runtime concurrency can confound differences.
credential_policy: Per-unit isolated OpenCode OAuth view of existing Codex subscription credentials. No API fallback, model substitution or modification of the original login file.
